thesis: The pages show a well-specified publish plan for a five-file folder and a named target dataset URL, but every page read is a proposal or a triage comment, not the live Hub listing, so the artifact should be treated as described-but-unverified rather than published. It is still worth knowing as a small, checkable example of a self-testing index folder, provided a reader verifies the live page and file list directly.

risks: No page read shows the live Hugging Face dataset page, its status line or its served file list, so the existence and contents of the published dataset are unconfirmed

The fixture folders the index reportedly points at are described but no page read shows them in the repository
